reviews.content:
Snapchat used to be a fun and simple way to connect with friends and maintain friendships. But over time, the developers slowly and surely turned this app into a wicked money grab, designed to keep the users trapped in an inescapable loop.

They’ve made several questionable choices with  features they added and changes they made, but this whole new storage on your memories thing is a whole new level. Forcing users to pay to keep years worth of memories is like some twisted hostage situation everyone is mortified to see but helpless to do anything about. Either you succumb and give them your money, refuse and lose thousands of treasured memories, or waste countless hours trying to find some other solution that will undoubtedly involve a needlessly complicated and a gruelling process.

Seriously, repeat it in your head—‘pay up or lose all your memories.’ With a 12 month deadline on it!! This is dystopian and honestly scary—whats next? It seems we’ve already hit rock bottom, but Snapchat has been consistent in proving it always has another nasty surprise ready.

Despite how appalled everyone is at this, we all know that our collective disgust and outrage means little to these rich corporations. They won’t do anything to fix this or show any sort of remorse. With all these recent world events, its become even more apparent how billionaires don’t care about the people, and its reflected daily in all sorts of ways. The least we can do is try salvage what we can, and take our business elsewhere before we can be exploited any further.
reviews.title: Another evil corporate consumed by greed

reviews.content:
Teams just about deafened me. I can’t hear properly in one ear anymore. 

When starting or joining a call, if the audio device is accidentally set to “Speaker” rather than “iPhone”, and you then put your phone to your ear, the audio will come at an extremely high volume that’s likely to cause hearing damage. This is unacceptable. There are a few issues with the design that can lead to this:

1) Teams doesn’t seem to make use of the proximity sensor in every iPhone to determine if the phone is being held to the user’s ear, which is a basic safety device they have chosen to bypass 
2) The icons for “Speaker” and “iPhone” are almost identical: both are icons of speakers, but one is filled in white, and one is an outline only. There are no clear visuals indications in the icon that they are different
3) Teams uses the terms “speaker” and “iPhone” to differentiate between the loudspeaker and the handset speaker. Both are speakers. Both are on the iPhone - neither name really clearly differentiates between the two. 

This is a safety hazard that has the potential to cause significant long-term harm to users.
reviews.title: Deafened me

reviews.content:
Are you SERIOUS, Snapchat? Charging for Memories storage now? You are a multi-billion dollar global company that rakes in obscene amounts of money through ads, sponsorships, and premium features, and now you want to nickel and dime users for storing their own memories? This is beyond pathetic. It’s disgustingly greedy.

Memories was one of the only redeeming features left on this app a way to keep track of personal moments, save important chats, and revisit good times. And now you want to throw a paywall in front of that? This isn’t innovation. This is corporate extortion.

You act like you’re offering some high-end cloud storage service, but it’s literally just personal photos and videos that YOU encouraged us to save within your app. Now you’re holding them hostage unless we pay? Unbelievable. You clearly don’t care about your user base, only your bottom line.

Do you not make enough money shoving endless ads down our throats every five seconds? With your massive valuation, ad revenue, sponsored filters, and premium subscriptions, you STILL felt the need to charge people to keep their memories? That’s not just greedy. It’s shameless.

I REFUSE to give Snapchat another cent, and I absolutely refuse to use the app going forward. There are far better platforms out there that don’t charge you to look back at your own life.

Snapchat used to be about connection, fun, and spontaneity. Now it’s just a cash-grab operation exploiting its users every chance it gets. You’ve officially lost all respect from me, and I know I’m not the only one.

fix this or disappear
reviews.title: Absolutely Disgusted – Snapchat’s Greed Has No Limits

reviews.content: Low rating as these problems have been going on for many months without any improvement. * Why doesn’t the app indicate which shorts I’ve watched? * A user should be able to search within a channel, as they can when using YouTube through an Internet browser. Instead the user had to painfully globally search for the name of the channel, which can be lengthy, difficult to spell or form part of natural language, as well as all the search terms. * The searching of your watch history is faulty and returns incomplete results. I’ve watched a fair amount of Critical Role and when searching to find the latest one I’ve watched it instead finds sporadic episodes and not all of them nor the latest one I’ve watched. * The “suggested video” that superimposed over the video at the end of it playing gets in the way of what I want to do, often to rewind the video I’ve just played to see certain bits or to select a card that was presented during the video. I’d like a way to disable this as it detracts from my experience. * I really don’t like the next and previous video controls appearing where they do on the video as you tap it It’s far too easy to accidentally press them when rewinding or forwarding a video, and then whether you skip back to the video you were watching it either plays from the very start or from a place very different from where you left off. Very frustrating. The next and previous video controls should be put somewhere else. * If you skip back to a video having skipped from it, it should resume from the position that you left it. It currently sits not remember where it was previously in that scenario. * Playlist queue management is sorely lacking. I want to be able to clear a playlist queue. For example if I clock on a video that is part of a playlist I want to be able to clear the queue so I don’t play any of the other videos in that queue. Annoyingly and clumsily you have to exit entirely the playlist you didn’t want to join in the first place, then go back to the video and then hold down and select to as it to a new queue of itself. When you don’t want to be in a queue at all. * An option should be introduced so that the the forward and back options on the Lock Screen when the phone is locked, and on the Apple watch, and if using AirPods next/previous function, to work as skip forward/back 10 seconds instead of skip to next/previous video. When listening to a long video I would appreciate being able to do that rather than have to unlock the phone, rewards back the part I missed before playing again and locking the phone. * Why no timer function to stop playing when the timer runs out? So I can use this when going to sleep. * I would like to be able to set a bookmark that bookmarks the video playing at the current time in the video and then be able to return to that bookmark * why can you not tell which shorts you have watched before or filter them out?. * I want to be able to filter out what I consider to be lie quality channels from my search and feed. * creates a transcript but doesn’t let you search it. What is the point?

reviews.content:
I love YouTube but I really think it could be way better if it took some ideas from TikTok. It would be awesome if we could repost other people’s videos directly to our own channel or Shorts, like how TikTok lets you repost to your followers — this would help good videos spread faster.

Also, I wish we could see exactly who subscribes to us, not just a number or only the public ones. It would make it feel more personal and help creators connect with their audience.

The audio library on Shorts could be improved too — TikTok has way more trending sounds and better editing for syncing clips to audio. Better filters and effects would help people make more creative videos without needing extra apps.

Overall, I really hope YouTube keeps adding more features like these to compete with TikTok and help creators grow!

About a month ago, my account was hacked for no reason while I was playing Ink Games. I believe this was caused by hackers using third-party exploits such as Krnl or Delta, which unfortunately still haven’t been removed from Roblox.

Because of this, I lost an account that I had invested a lot of Robux into, and I was forced to create new accounts just to keep playing. Even though I love Roblox and think it’s a great game overall, the fact that hackers are still able to exploit without proper action being taken is frustrating and discouraging for long-term players like me.

The account I use now has been with me for over two years, and I would really like to continue using it for many more without having to worry about it being taken away again. I hope Roblox continues to improve their security and takes stronger action against exploiters so that loyal players can enjoy the platform safely.

reviews.content: Snapchat’s new storage update is honestly such a bad idea because nobody asked for it and it just makes the app more annoying. Instead of keeping Snapchat simple and fun, now it feels like they’re trying to copy other apps and cram in features that we don’t even want. Most teens already struggle with phone storage, and having Snapchat take up even more space just to “save memories” is unnecessary when we already have our camera roll. It slows the app down, makes our phones lag, and takes away from what Snapchat was originally for quick snaps and streaks, not a storage system. They should just remove it and go back to keeping things simple, because that’s what actually made people love the app.
